scope: Independent static operational review of exactly two root-adapted isolated verification helpers and current config; not a native scientific or runtime publication acceptance.
authorship: Reviewer authored wood-ash and its statistical wording correction; independent owner acceptance belongs to root. Reviewer did not author these helper adaptations.

checks.name: Exact derivation
checks.result: Both helper sources equal round95 predecessors after only round95/Round95 and trusted base replacement; full current sources read and Python AST parsed without execution.

checks.name: Source and clone boundaries
checks.result: Source Git is read-only. New clone/output names reject existing files and symlinks; supplied object IDs and run IDs are constrained. Archive paths reject absolute/traversal/.git members and data extraction filter applies. Source tree identity is checked; preflight source HEAD/clean status and fresh remote main base are required.

checks.name: Squash and queue contract
checks.result: Postmerge requires coordinator-deleted local/remote topic refs, actual fresh-main merge SHA, exact sole trusted-base parent and exact tree. No push, enqueue, dispatch or deletion by these helpers; native queue admission itself is a separate coordinator step.

checks.name: Provenance isolation
checks.result: Single-branch main clone plus tags only; topic object absence checked before/after reconstruction and after validation. Retained annotated tag object and peeled commit checked locally and remotely. Read-only current source tag query matched constants fc4040c3abcd28f0a9cc52467e308100144ad1fd and c0adc2c0763e1515ed07dc712b024974d98fb342.

checks.name: Exact scientific coverage
checks.result: Hidden/ignored-inclusive filesystem enumeration follows relevant symlinks with cycle prevention. Coverage requires completed positive scientific review, exact target ID/path, reviewed-target scope and current source SHA; every distinct review base must be an available commit. Counts checked against current config. Canonical review checker precedes this supplemental coverage audit.

checks.name: Honest check scope
checks.result: Fresh clone executes locked offline dependencies, strict record/history/native review and exact coverage checks; it does not rerun the unchanged full suite. Exact-tree full-suite receipt must be verified separately by publication coordinator. Full original-main/unrelated-worktree inventory preservation is outside these two helpers and cannot be inferred from their eventual success.

limitations: Static review only; no helper top-level execution, network calls, queue activity or filesystem mutation beyond this review pair.

Config counts are intended assertions (465 records,533 histories,550 reviews,97 bases,465 covered), not measurements from this audit. Final native saves and actual canonical checks/coverage remain prerequisites.
Current config lacks issues/publication IDs by design at this preparation stage. Later commit/head/tree/CI/queue/merge/issue and preservation evidence require independent runtime binding.
No new tests were run because the two scripts are exact literal cohort adaptations without behavioral changes.
